probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Halden® Pricing Changelog Help Blog About Overview Buy Halden App Store Google Play © 2026 Halden® 3 min read October 14, 2026 Plan tomorrow tonight Five minutes in the evening saves the first hour of the morning. By Marta Ruiz Most mornings start with the same question: what now? You open the laptop, check the inbox, skim a few messages and by the time you have decided what matters, the best hour of the day has gone to deciding. Halden exists because we kept losing that hour. The fix is not a better morning routine. It is moving the decision to the evening before, when today is still fresh and tomorrow has not started pulling at you yet. The five minute version At 21:30 Halden asks one question: what is tomorrow’s one thing? Answering it takes less time than brushing your teeth. Look at what today’s thing was and whether it got done. If it did not, decide whether it is still the most important thing. Often it is. Write tomorrow’s thing in a few words and close the app. That is the whole routine.
